title: LLM Enrichment Output
description: Schema for one enrichment record from the §8 LLM step. The model proposes language (name/description/responsibilities) for an EXISTING element id; it may NOT add relationships (plan §8.1/§8.3). Validated, then referential-integrity-checked (every element_id must already exist). See plans/2026-06-03-fact-extraction-structurizr-pipeline.md §8.2.
$comment: This object is CLOSED (additionalProperties:false): the LLM contract is fully enumerated, and any extra field is a contract violation that must trigger the §8.3 bounded-retry / degrade policy rather than pass silently. Folded into the §8.3 cache key via sha256(llm-output.schema.json).

element_id.description: Must match an existing fact-model element id (§6.3). Referential integrity enforced post-validation.

element_name.description: Proposed C4 display name. Loses to a §7.4 name_overrides pin in the deterministic reconciler (§8.3).

description.description: Short description; may be empty on degrade (§8.3 terminal policy).

naming_confidence.description: ENRICHMENT confidence (§8.2), distinct from extraction confidence (§6.3). Advisory; cross-checked against deterministic evidence-strength (§8.3).

evidence.description: The extracted facts the name/description were grounded in (file paths, namespaces, top dependencies). Citations, not new structure.
